<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918633_theRebbe_459" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918633_theRebbe_459__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header of the maamar for Shabbos Bamidbar, Rosh Chodesh Sivan, 5729.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Bamidbar,</t>
    <t s="2">Rosh Chodesh and Erev Rosh Chodesh Sivan,</t>
    <t s="3">5729</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the Gemara's derivation that the phrase "on that day" in the verse about entering the Sinai desert refers to Rosh Chodesh, and Tosafos' question about why a different gezeirah shavah was not used.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"In the third month of the children of Israel's going out from the land of Egypt, on that day they came to the Sinai desert."</t>
    <t s="1">And it is brought in the Gemara,</t>
    <t s="2">It is written here "on that day they came to the Sinai desert" and it is written there</t>
    <t s="3">"This month shall be for you the beginning of months,"</t>
    <t s="4">just as there it is Rosh Chodesh, so too here it is Rosh Chodesh.</t>
    <t s="5">And Tosafos questioned,</t>
    <t s="6">for in Tractate Pesachim</t>
    <t s="7">it is brought</t>
    <t s="8">(on the verse</t>
    <t s="9">"And Hashem spoke to Moshe in the Sinai desert in the second year... in the first month"),</t>
    <t s="10">it derives "desert" from "desert,"</t>
    <t s="11">it is written here "in the Sinai desert" and it is written there</t>
    <t s="12">"And Hashem spoke to Moshe in the Sinai desert, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first of the second month,"</t>
    <t s="13">just as there it is on Rosh Chodesh, so too here it is on Rosh Chodesh,</t>
    <t s="14">and since in the verse "in the third month" it also says "desert,"</t>
    <t s="15">why did it not derive here "desert" from "desert"?</t>
    <t s="16">And it needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="17">for ostensibly,</t>
    <t s="18">the derivation from the gezeirah shavah of "this" "this" reveals that the explanation of "on that day" is Rosh Chodesh,</t>
    <t s="19">unlike if they had learned from the gezeirah shavah of "desert" from "desert"</t>
    <t s="20">[where the teaching is only that the matter stated in the verse</t>
    <t s="21">("they came to the Sinai desert")</t>
    <t s="22">was on Rosh Chodesh]</t>
    <t s="23">the explanation of "on that day" would not be understood</t>
    <t s="24">[And there is a further advantage in the gezeirah shavah of "this" "this" over the gezeirah shavah of "desert" from "desert,"</t>
    <t s="25">for "this month" its explanation is Rosh Chodesh,</t>
    <t s="26">unlike "Sinai desert" and "first of the month"</t>
    <t s="27">(Rosh Chodesh)</t>
    <t s="28">which are two separate matters],</t>
    <t s="29">and what is the reasoning of Tosafos that it should have derived "desert" from "desert"?</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the essence of receiving the Torah is the power given to each Jew for their Torah study to be in a state of utter self-nullification, which is connected to the revelation of Kesser on Shavuos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood according to what is explained in Torah Ohr, the discourse beginning with the word "Zeh,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the essence</t>
    <t s="3">of receiving the Torah is as it is written</t>
    <t s="4">(at the beginning of the matter of the Giving of the Torah)</t>
    <t s="5">"And Elokim spoke all these words, saying,"</t>
    <t s="6">for the explanation of the word "saying" in this verse is that at the time of the Giving of the Torah, the power was given to every single Jew,</t>
    <t s="7">that his study of Torah</t>
    <t s="8">[all these words,</t>
    <t s="9">which also refers to the entire Torah]</t>
    <t s="10">would be in the manner of "to say,"</t>
    <t s="11">to repeat the matters that the Holy One, blessed is He, says,</t>
    <t s="12">as it is written</t>
    <t s="13">"My tongue will answer Your word,"</t>
    <t s="14">that the Torah is "Your word,"</t>
    <t s="15">that my tongue answers like one who answers after the speaker.</t>
    <t s="16">And this is the connection of the Giving of the Torah to the holiday of Shavuos,</t>
    <t s="17">for on Shavuos is the drawing down of Kesser</t>
    <t s="18">[and as is known</t>
    <t s="19">in the explanation of the verse</t>
    <t s="20">"You shall count fifty days,"</t>
    <t s="21">that on Shavuos the fiftieth gate of Binah is drawn down,</t>
    <t s="22">and the fiftieth gate is Kesser],</t>
    <t s="23">and this that at the Giving of the Torah the power was given that the Torah study of Israel would be in ultimate self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="24">that he has no independent existence at all and is only like one who answers after the caller,</t>
    <t s="25">is because at the Giving of the Torah the revelation of Kesser was drawn down.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
